Actively learning German (A1) and seeking an international Automation, Mechatronics, or Controls Engineer position in Germany.

Programmed, operated, and troubleshot industrial PLC, HMI, and SCADA automation lines for continuous manufacturing processes. Designed, fabricated, and validated electro-mechanical systems. Collaborated across multidisciplinary engineering teams to enhance automation reliability, cycle time, and factory uptime.
